issues.detail: The Hebrew 'שִׁבֹּלֶת מַיִם' means 'flood of water' or 'torrent of water', not '耳麥的水' (water of earbuds/ears of grain). 'שִׁבֹּלֶת' can mean 'ear of grain' but in this context with 'מַיִם' it clearly means 'flood/torrent'. The Chinese rendering '耳麥的水' is a mistranslation that changes the meaning.
